Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Backoffice 1.0.100

1. Fixed: after "Restart to update" the app no longer shows a crash notice at the next start.
2. The TradeNextFX logo mark and app icon are the brand's own artwork; the top-left header and the bottom-left status line show the logo mark with the name in the brand's own two colours.
3. Each broker's app keeps its own saved sign-ins and settings, so apps from different brokers on one PC never share them. Settings has an Uninstall option that also removes this app's saved data (ticked by default).
4. Dealing chart: zoom in much further, solid crisp candles, follows the live edge, one clean menu style, crisp drawing tools, and easier-to-pick position lines and tags with a red close cross on hover and a highlighted selection.

Backoffice 1.0.100

  1. Fixed: after "Restart to update" the app no longer shows a crash notice at the next start.
  2. The TradeNextFX logo mark and app icon are the brand's own artwork; the top-left header and the bottom-left status line show the logo mark with the name in the brand's own two colours.
  3. Each broker's app keeps its own saved sign-ins and settings, so apps from different brokers on one PC never share them. Settings has an Uninstall option that also removes this app's saved data (ticked by default).
  4. Dealing chart: zoom in much further, solid crisp candles, follows the live edge, one clean menu style, crisp drawing tools, and easier-to-pick position lines and tags with a red close cross on hover and a highlighted selection.
